_meta.theme: local-pool onboarding — probe round: same design as round 15 (small real tasks exercise the builtin loop), first worker in the array is the new local-deepseek so config-order tie-breaks give it the first attempt; zai/tud/saia baselines ride along for UCB1 win-rate data
_meta.design: T1 is the smallest real change (one function + one test on src/cost.rs). T2 needs an edit to existing code (doc comment) — the second tool path. Gates stay deliberately light (grep + cargo) so failures point at the harness or the model, not gate plumbing.

tasks.title: r16-probe-basis: add pub fn basis_label(b: &Basis) -> &'static str returning "priced" or "sized" in src/cost.rs, pinned by one test in tests/contract_config.rs
tasks.accept: grep -q 'fn basis_label' src/cost.rs && cargo test --lib && cargo test --test contract_config

tasks.title: r16-probe-doc: extend the module doc of src/cost.rs to name the two Basis variants (Priced, Sized) and state that Priced wins the comparison
tasks.accept: grep -q 'Priced' src/cost.rs && grep -q 'Sized' src/cost.rs && cargo build && cargo test --lib
